mods.name: grid-containers
mods.description: Grid container windows: resizable panel, search and sort, pins, free placement, quick move (Ctrl+click) and multi-move (Shift+drag), plus corpse grid. Replaces the client's classic container windows while on.

mods.name: journal
mods.description: Tabbed, resizable system-log window: All/Sys/Chat/Party/Guild plus custom tabs, hue/hide rules, overhead speech, wheel scrollback, UO fonts, fades in on hover, click-through when idle. Replaces the client's built-in log.
